hero.title: Axopar 22 T-Top
hero.heading: Axopar 22 T-Top
hero.subheading: Axopar's Winning Formula All Fused Into A 22-Footer, Under A T-Top Roof
hero.intro: A trailerable sportboat built for fast transfers and all‑weather adventure. The Axopar 22 T‑Top brings a new level of fun, freedom, and functionality to the 22‑footer class. This sleek, versatile model adds the protection of a stylish T‑Top without sacrificing the thrill of open‑air boating. Agile, stable, and packed with smart design details, the 22 T‑Top delivers one of the best driving experiences in its size category at the solid, competitive pricing Axopar is known for.

sections.title: The Best 22 Footer on the Market
sections.intro:
The unique and eye-grabbing Axopar 22 not only has the looks but is a true performer offering one of the best driving experiences ever; unparalleled stability, agility, and handling, combined with class-best seaworthiness. Built to match your needs.
For the best experience on the water!

sections.title: Easy to Handle
sections.intro: With the same DNA as its bigger siblings, the 22 T-Top offers responsive handling and safe mannerisms, that enables you to relax, and focus on having a good time out on the water. The twin-step, low center of gravity hull with deep-vee configuration assures good directional stability and fantastic grip during cornering.

sections.title: Clean Helm Area
sections.intro: The uncluttered and intuitive helm area is developed so that you will have full control over the boat and its functions in all situations.

sections.title: Trailerability
sections.intro: Easy to trailer almost anywhere, the Axopar 22 lets you launch in new waters and discover hidden islands. With an optional toilet and coastal certification, you can enjoy comfortable, full-day adventures with friends and family.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

items.caption: The Axopar 22's responsive handling, stability, and agility, combined with best-in-class seaworthiness, bring true joy to the driving experience.
The spacious front deck perfectly stores your favourite water toys, but can also be turned into a dining area with the optional removable table.

The angle of the windscreen is adjustable, providing full protection while you are seated and allowing you to raise the top of the windscreen higher for protection while driving in a standing position.
The optional U-sofa provides a great hang-out area for guests while onboard. It can be upgraded further with an optional table and a Sundeck Cushion.

items.name: Walk-around Center Console
items.title: Walk-around Center Console
items.text: The walkaround center console allows for seamless movement, giving you better control in situations such as mooring. The center console also includes a large storage compartment/optional toilet compartment.

items.name: Splash Proof USB Outlet in the Console
items.title: Splash Proof USB Outlet in the Console
items.text: Never miss the chance to capture and share every moment, by keeping the juice in your handheld devices topped up. The splash-proof USB outlet is IPX6 classified and can charge two devices at the same time, with 2.1 A per outlet.

items.name: Storage Possibilities
items.title: Storage Possibilities
items.text: Bringing along water toys, camping gear, or some other adventure equipment? You can conveniently store it all away in one of the many storage spaces located across the boat.

items.name: Large Harbour Cover for Console and Front Seats
items.title: Large Harbour Cover for Console and Front Seats
items.text: Harbour covers protect the most used areas of the boat, keeping them safe from rain, sunlight, and dust. Easy assembly with sturdy fasteners. (Spyder model in picture.)

items.name: Storage Pocket for Center Console Wall
items.title: Storage Pocket for Center Console Wall
items.text: The storage pocket lets you stow away all the nick-nacks that you bring on your adventures.

sections.title: Alternatives For Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform thinking enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout to suit your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar T-Top comes with an Aft Sofa. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Multi Storage Compartment or a U-sofa, with the possibility of extending it into a sun bed.

items.name: Multi Storage Compartment
items.title: Multi Storage Compartment
items.text: Further enhance the storage space and lounging options onboard with the multi storage compartment that serves as seats for passengers when underway, and a spacious hangout spot when at anchor, with plenty of storage room underneath.

items.name: Toilet Compartment
items.title: Toilet Compartment
items.text: Extend the time spent out on the water and improve comfort on board by selecting either the manual or electric-flush toilet package, which uses the generous space in the front of the center console.

items.name: Seating in the Bow
items.title: Seating in the Bow
items.text: By adding the optional front deck seat and forward-facing console seat, with a table on the front deck, you can create a perfect lounge spot, where you can enjoy a snack, beverage, and the company of your guests.

items.name: Waterski Frame
items.title: Waterski Frame
items.text: True to its nature, the 22 range offers a waterski frame as an option; a must-have for anyone looking to engage in watersports.

items.name: Audio
items.title: Audio
items.text: By choosing the Audio Entertainment System Upgrade, you can maximise your on-water experience and set the ambience onboard by shuffling your favourite playlist and letting the music drive your adventure.

sections.title: Configurations & Layouts
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of available layouts.

items.title: Multi Storage Compartment
items.text: with Optional Silvertex Hunter Upholstery, Forward Facing Seat with Bolsters, Table on Fore Deck, and BRABUS Line

items.title: Multi Storage Compartment
items.text: with Optional Seine PE Taupe (Mediterrana Edition) Upholstery, Driver's Sofa, Forward Facing Seat, and BRABUS Line

items.title: BRABUS Line
modal_text: Includes black cleats, side rails, pulpits (option), waterski frame (option), rub rail (option), ventilation and speaker grills, and the Axopar hull logo in black. Additionally, there will be a steering wheel with BRABUS embossing, a BRABUS map pocket, and BRABUS badges on the boat.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 22 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White. These duo-tone color options combine colored areas with uncolored sections in a standard white finish, giving the boat a dynamic and distinctive look.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: The BRABUS Performance Line features stylish hull graphics and an extra boost of power on the transom, courtesy of a Mercury Verado 250hp engine, to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
The upholstery features exclusive, subtle yet stylish detailing, accentuated patterns, and a structured feel of marine fabrics. The fabric keeps the interior and lounging areas at comfortable temperatures, even on the warmest summer days.

The Mediterrana Edition features and options:

Outdoor waterproof fabric

Extended fore deck seating with cupholders and bolsters

Mediterrana Soft Decking

Extended sun bed cushions on the Multi Storage Compartment

Extended sun bed cushions for u-sofa

Harbor covers

items.title: AXOPAR X JOBE EDITION
modal_text: YOUR PASSPORT TO A TOTAL WATER SPORTS EXPERIENCE

Here at Axopar, we felt the need to offer an even deeper, more immersive water sports experience aboard our new Axopar 22 Spyder.

This was how two of the world’s leading manufacturers found each other: the iconic Jobe Sports from the Netherlands and Axopar Boats from Finland. Together, we are now the first partnership to produce a boat range specifically tailored to its matching water-sports products. Our shared passion for fun on the water, innovation, knowhow and years of experience would together allow us to create one of the best water sports concepts in the leisure marine industry.
